audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits: Karma pokes early with range and Mantra, Veigar takes over from first item and hard-outscales. Content prose and packet agree.
Spikes present and grounded: her 3-5 RQ-root poke phase, even level 6, Veigar first item, Veigar late. All four content spikes exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carried blanket 'Skill' on rows 0-3 and 5 while content win[] and packet say Karma 0-3 and Veigar at first item; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; enemyWin was a name-swap template; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; 18 misgender hits; anti-heal vs her Mantra-W healing unmentioned.
audit.why: Karma W is 12s flat with a 2s tether-to-root; Mantra is 40s rank 1 and her passive Gathering Fire refunds it off spell hits; her E shields and speeds her out of Dark Matter. Her Mantra-W heals, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Chart rows 0-3 moved to Karma and row 5 to Veigar with matching why rewrites (win[] already agrees — side-only per the chart rule); cooldowns rewritten with 12s/40s/20s; enemyWin grounded; bleed bullets replaced with Gathering Fire and execute facts; Oblivion Orb added to itemization.
